name: Chess endgame: Phong diffuse under a rectangular and a spherical area light (soft shadows)
description: Chess pieces (smooth meshes of revolution) on a two-tone board, lit by a one-sided 1.4 x 1.0 emissive rectangle above the left and a glowing sphere on the right, maxdepth 1. Pixels in umbrae, penumbrae and fully lit squares test the area-light estimators and their sampling density.
